title: Preserved multi-company scope in statement follow-ups
points: Follow-up statement questions now recover a bounded recent ticker set from chat history when the current query refers to prior figures without repeating a company name.
Added a regression for FCFE-style borrowing follow-ups after SYS and NATF conversations so the router does not ask for scope again.
Documented the bounded multi-ticker follow-up recovery rule in the analysis spec.
